text:
maria: Quick check — I'm seeing inconsistent route selection when we combine time-window overrides with header-based service anchors. Example: requests with X-Quota-Group get routed to special service during PST 9-5, but tie-break picks the host-specific default instead. Anyone seen this?
raj: yep saw similar in load test yesterday. repro steps?
maria: Steps:
1) header X-Quota-Group: beta
2) Host matches *.internal.example.com
3) time-window override active (schedule: weekdays 16:00-00:00 UTC)
Result: should pick service: quota-beta, ends up picking service: default-weighted
kim: config snippet:
```yaml
match:
  host: "*.internal.example.com"
  headers: { "X-Quota-Group": "beta" }
overrides:
  time_window:
    schedule: "Mon-Fri 16:00-00:00"
route:
  services:
    - name: quota-beta
      weight: 1
    - name: default
      weight: 100
```
ben: Weight bias explains it — weights still applied after overrides. We treat overrides as additive not exclusive. That was intentional for gradual rollouts.
maria: We need deterministic precedence: time-window override should be stronger than header anchor, or at least have a tie-break ranking. Current model uses anchor_score + weight, which causes surprises.
sana: Could we add "override_priority" numeric field? Higher wins over weights. Also emit telemetry tag match_reason = ["time_window","header_anchor"] so console shows why route chosen.
rick: alternative: change evaluation order — evaluate static anchors (host/header) -> apply exclusive overrides (time-window can mark route as 'pinned') -> then apply weighting only between remaining candidates.
raj: also consider JWT-claim derived anchors (org_id). Those should be same class as headers.
maria: Agree. Also need a migration plan: existing customers rely on weights; can't flip overnight. Proposal:
- add override_priority (default 0)
- time-windowed overrides set priority 10
- header anchors default 5
- roll out feature flag and a console hint
ben: Can we add unit tests in matcher with scenario matrix (host, header, jwt, time-window, weights)? I can add.
kim: UI ask: console should show "Match trace" with bullet list and final score. Minimal: add the match_reason tags and expose in per-route telemetry.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: matcher-v0.9.8 -> staging at 2571234578
maria: Action items: @ben add tests, @kim add telemetry fields + console hint, @raj spec migration RFC. I'll write a short RFC. :+1:
raj: I'll start RFC draft. thanks. :raised_hands:
